LESSON: PUTTING

Grade: PP2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: NUMBERS
Topic 2.8: Putting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Putting. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify sets of similar objects together with a sum not objects in the environment exceeding 9 and count. for counting • Two learners demonstrate putting
2. enjoy the activities of putting • In small groups

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: PUTTING
Putting is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Putting problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Putting question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Putting question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Putting set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Putting.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Putting in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify sets of similar objects together with a sum not objects in the environment exceeding 9 and count. for counting • Two learners demonstrate putting
2. enjoy the activities of putting • In small groups

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
